cohort: The study included 75 pregnant women treated in COVID-19 non-intensive isolation wards in Indonesia throughout 2021.
finding: 16% of pregnant women hospitalized due to COVID-19 met the criteria for PTSD symptoms, but no significant association was found with employment status or delivery method.
mod_finding: No significant difference in PTSD symptoms occurrence was found based on delivery method (caesarean section vs. spontaneous delivery).
cross-section timing: Throughout 2021, concurrent with hospitalization for COVID-19.
